name: How long does it take to tile a bathroom shower from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to tile a bathroom shower from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete shower tile installation usually takes between 3 to 7 working days, depending on scope, curing times, and custom features. Demolition, plumbing adjustments, and backer board installation take the first day or two. Applying waterproof membranes, tile setting, and allowing mortar to cure requires another two to three days. Finally, grouting, caulking, and cleanup wrap up the project. Custom mosaic patterns, built-in niches, bench seating, or structural drywall repairs behind old fixtures can extend the timeline before the shower is ready for daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: A complete shower tile installation typically takes 3 to 7 days, allowing necessary drying time for waterproofing, thinset mortar, and grout.
